platform.description: Post-rebrand Windows-checkout source contracts, rolled forward for issue #133 named layouts after auditing the session parser changes. The parser keeps the reviewed .allocate = .alloc_always ownership fix and decodes layout placement as opaque JSON before constructing the strict placement-free shape; the on-disk schema remains unchanged at v1. Hashes reflect checkout normalization. The durable git_commit identifies the PR base; Contracts.99-Baselines.ps1 independently pins the reviewed session-schema digest so squash-merging and deleting the PR branch cannot disable fail-closed artifact verification.
